newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres shareholders okay transfer of media unit.
newsitem.headline: Benpres shareholders okay transfer of media unit.

text.p: Shareholders of Benpres Holdings Corp on Wednesday approved the transfer of its media unit, ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp and Sky Vision Corp, to parent Lopez Inc, a company official said.
ABS-CBN is being spun off to enable foreign investors to buy Benpres stocks, currently not possible because Philippine law prevents foreigners from owning media companies.
Lopez owns 80 percent of Benpres and under the agreement Benpres will transfer ABS-CBN to Lopez.
In return Lopez will issue 25-year convertible notes to Benpres.
Benpres chief executive officer Rafael Andrada told reporters after the company's stockholders meeting the transfer would not affect Benpres.
"On a proforma basis, it should have no negative effect on earnings," he said.
He said Benpres would have the option of converting the notes into shares provided the law then allowed it.
